title: Fictional instruction-card walkthrough notebook
provenance: An authored research-reading exercise. These are not published findings, recruited participants or measured human-subject results.
scope: The same fictional facilitator completes three scripted walkthroughs per card. Order is not counterbalanced and no untrained reader is represented.
uncertainty_meaning: Bounds are the minimum and maximum of three fictional walkthrough times per card, not confidence intervals or population error estimates.

facilitator_note.text: The slow Icons walkthrough included a pause at an unfamiliar symbol.
facilitator_note.qualification: The note does not isolate the symbol as the cause of the pause or of total task time.

proposal: Repeat with untrained readers and counterbalanced order before choosing an instruction-card format.
